### Total Annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Operational Costs: $40M {#sec-dfda_annual_opex}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment operational costs (sum of all components: $15M + $10M + $8M + $5M + $2M)

**Inputs**:

- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Maintenance Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_platform_maintenance): $15M (95% CI: $10M - $22M)
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Staff Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_staff): $10M (95% CI: $7M - $15M)
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Infrastructure Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_infrastructure): $8M (95% CI: $5M - $12M)
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Regulatory Coordination Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_regulatory): $5M (95% CI: $3M - $8M)
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Community Support Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_community): $2M (95% CI: $1M - $3M)

$$
\begin{gathered}
OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M
\end{gathered}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

### Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Annual Benefit: R&D Savings: $58.6B {#sec-dfda_benefit_rd_only_annual}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment benefit from R&D savings (trial cost reduction, secondary component)

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Global Spending on Clinical Trials](#sec-global_clinical_trials_spending_annual) 📊: $60B (95% CI: $50B - $75B)
- [dFDA Trial Cost Reduction Percentage](#sec-dfda_trial_cost_reduction_pct) 🔢: 97.7%

$$
\begin{gathered}
Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= Spending_{trials} \times Reduce_{pct} \\
= \$60B \times 97.7\% \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\%
\end{gathered}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

### Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Annual Net Savings (R&D Only): $58.6B {#sec-dfda_net_savings_rd_only_annual}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Annual net savings from R&D cost reduction only (gross savings minus operational costs, excludes regulatory delay value)

**Inputs**:

- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Annual Benefit: R&D Savings](#sec-dfda_benefit_rd_only_annual) 🔢: $58.6B
- [Total Annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Operational Costs](#sec-dfda_annual_opex) 🔢: $40M

$$
\begin{gathered}
Savings_{RD,ann} \\
= Benefit_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$58.6B - \$40M \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= Spending_{trials} \times Reduce_{pct} \\
= \$60B \times 97.7\% \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\% \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M
\end{gathered}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

### Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Total NPV Cost: $611M {#sec-dfda_npv_total_cost}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total NPV cost (upfront + PV of annual opex)

**Inputs**:

- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Present Value of Annual OPEX Over 10 Years](#sec-dfda_npv_pv_annual_opex) 🔢: $342M
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Total NPV Upfront Costs](#sec-dfda_npv_upfront_cost_total) 🔢: $270M

$$
\begin{gathered}
Cost_{dFDA,total} \\
= PV_{OPEX} + Cost_{upfront,total} \\
= \$342M + \$270M \\
= \$611M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } PV_{OPEX} \\
= \frac{T_{horizon}}{OPEX_{total} \times r_{discount}} \\
= \frac{10}{\$40M \times 3\%} \\
= \$342M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{total} \\
= OPEX_{ann} + OPEX_{DIH,ann} \\
= \$18.9M + \$21.1M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{upfront,total} \\
= Cost_{upfront} + Cost_{DIH,init} \\
= \$40M + \$230M \\
= \$270M
\end{gathered}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

= Benefit_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\

= Spending_{trials} \times Reduce_{pct} \\
= \$60B \times 97.7\% \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\% \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{dFDA,total} \\
= PV_{OPEX} + Cost_{upfront,total} \\
= \$342M + \$270M \\
= \$611M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } PV_{OPEX} \\
= \frac{T_{horizon}}{OPEX_{total} \times r_{discount}} \\

\text{where } OPEX_{total} \\
= OPEX_{ann} + OPEX_{DIH,ann} \\
= \$18.9M + \$21.1M \\

### Global Governance Efficiency Score: 51.9% {#sec-political_dysfunction_global_efficiency_score}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Global Governance Efficiency Score from Political Dysfunction Tax paper. E = Adjusted W_real / W_max, where W_real = GDP - waste, W_max = W_real + opportunity cost. Paper calculates 30-52% efficiency (using $110.9T adjusted / $211.9T maximum). This means civilization operates at roughly half its technological potential.

**Inputs**:

- [Global GDP (2025)](#sec-global_gdp_2025) 📊: $115T
- [US Government Waste (Total)](#sec-us_gov_waste_total) 🔢: $4.90T
- [Global Fossil Fuel Subsidies](#sec-political_dysfunction_global_fossil_fuel_subsidies) 📊: $1.30T (95% CI: $1.10T - $1.50T)
- [Global Opportunity Cost Total](#sec-political_dysfunction_global_opportunity_cost_total) 🔢: $101T

$$
\begin{gathered}
E \\
= \frac{W_{real}}{W_{max}} \\
= \frac{GDP - W_{waste}}{GDP - W_{waste} + O_{total}}
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [@political-dysfunction-tax-paper-2025]

*? Low confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

### Global Opportunity Cost as % of GDP: 87.8% {#sec-political_dysfunction_global_opportunity_cost_pct_gdp}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Global opportunity cost as percentage of global GDP. $101T / $115T = ~88% of current GDP in unrealized potential. This represents the 'buried multipliers' of the global economy.

**Inputs**:

- [Global Opportunity Cost Total](#sec-political_dysfunction_global_opportunity_cost_total) 🔢: $101T
- [Global GDP (2025)](#sec-global_gdp_2025) 📊: $115T

$$
\begin{gathered}
O_{\%GDP} = \frac{O_{total}}{GDP_{global}} = \frac{\$101T}{\$115T} = 87.8\% \\[0.5em]
\text{where } O_{total} \\
= O_{health} + O_{science} + O_{lead} + O_{migration} \\
= \$34T + \$4T + \$6T + \$57T \\

### US Waste (% GDP): 17% {#sec-us_gov_waste_pct_gdp}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

US government waste as percentage of GDP. ~$4.90T waste / $28.78T GDP = ~17%. This represents the 'dysfunction tax' that American citizens effectively pay through inefficient governance.

**Inputs**:

- [US Government Waste (Total)](#sec-us_gov_waste_total) 🔢: $4.90T
- [US GDP (2024)](#sec-us_gdp_2024) 📊: $28.8T

$$
\begin{gathered}
W_{US,\%GDP} = \frac{W_{total,US}}{USGDP} = \frac{\$4.9T}{\$28.8T} = 17\% \\[0.5em]
\text{where } W_{total,US} = W_{raw,US} \times US = \$4.9T \times 1 = \$4.9T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } W_{raw,US} \\
= W_{health} + W_{housing} + W_{military} \\
+ W_{regulatory} + W_{tax} + W_{corporate} \\
+ W_{tariffs} + W_{drugs} + W_{fossil} \\
+ W_{agriculture} \\
= \$1.2T + \$1.4T + \$615B + \$580B + \$546B \\
+ \$181B + \$160B + \$90B + \$50B + \$75B \\
= \$4.9T
\end{gathered}
$$

*~ Medium confidence*

### US Gov Waste (Raw Total): $4.90T {#sec-us_gov_waste_raw_total}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Raw sum of US government waste components before overlap discount: healthcare ($1.2T) + housing ($1.4T) + military ($615B) + regulatory ($580B) + tax ($546B) + corporate ($181B) + tariffs ($160B) + drug war ($90B) + fossil fuel ($50B) + agriculture ($75B) = ~$4.9T raw.

**Inputs**:

- [Healthcare System Inefficiency](#sec-us_gov_waste_healthcare_inefficiency) 📊: $1.20T (95% CI: $1T - $1.50T)
- [Housing/Zoning Restrictions Cost](#sec-us_gov_waste_housing_zoning) 📊: $1.40T (95% CI: $1T - $2T)
- [Military Overspend](#sec-us_gov_waste_military_overspend) 📊: $615B (95% CI: $500B - $750B)
- [Regulatory Red Tape Waste](#sec-us_gov_waste_regulatory_red_tape) 📊: $580B (95% CI: $290B - $1T)
- [Tax Compliance Waste](#sec-us_gov_waste_tax_compliance) 📊: $546B (95% CI: $450B - $650B)
- [Corporate Welfare Waste](#sec-us_gov_waste_corporate_welfare) 📊: $181B (95% CI: $150B - $220B)
- [Tariff Cost (GDP Loss)](#sec-us_gov_waste_tariffs) 📊: $160B (95% CI: $90B - $250B)
- [Drug War Cost](#sec-us_gov_waste_drug_war) 📊: $90B (95% CI: $60B - $150B)
- [Fossil Fuel Subsidies (Explicit)](#sec-us_gov_waste_fossil_fuel_subsidies) 📊: $50B (95% CI: $30B - $80B)
- [Agricultural Subsidies Deadweight Loss](#sec-us_gov_waste_agricultural_subsidies) 📊: $75B (95% CI: $50B - $120B)

$$
\begin{gathered}
W_{raw,US} \\
= W_{health} + W_{housing} + W_{military} + W_{regulatory} \\
+ W_{tax} + W_{corporate} + W_{tariffs} + W_{drugs} \\
+ W_{fossil} + W_{agriculture} \\
= \$1.2T + \$1.4T + \$615B + \$580B + \$546B + \$181B + \$160B \\
+ \$90B + \$50B + \$75B \\
= \$4.9T
\end{gathered}
$$

*~ Medium confidence*

### US Government Waste (Total): $4.90T {#sec-us_gov_waste_total}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total annual US government waste (additive sum of components). Consolidates healthcare ($1.2T), housing ($1.4T), military ($615B), regulatory ($580B), tax ($546B), corporate ($181B), tariffs ($160B), drug war ($90B), fossil fuel ($50B), agriculture ($75B). Categories treated as additive; any overlap offset by excluded categories (state/local inefficiency, implicit subsidies, behavioral effects). ~$4.9T annually.

**Inputs**:

- [US Gov Waste (Raw Total)](#sec-us_gov_waste_raw_total) 🔢: $4.90T
- [Overlap Discount Factor](#sec-us_gov_waste_overlap_discount): 1:1

$$
\begin{gathered}
W_{total,US} = W_{raw,US} \times US = \$4.9T \times 1 = \$4.9T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } W_{raw,US} \\
= W_{health} + W_{housing} + W_{military} \\
+ W_{regulatory} + W_{tax} + W_{corporate} \\
+ W_{tariffs} + W_{drugs} + W_{fossil} \\
+ W_{agriculture} \\
= \$1.2T + \$1.4T + \$615B + \$580B + \$546B \\
+ \$181B + \$160B + \$90B + \$50B + \$75B \\
= \$4.9T
\end{gathered}
$$

*~ Medium confidence*

<script>
// Conservative lazy loading: only load images actually in viewport
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  let imageObserver = null;
  let loadTimeout = null;
  
  function enableLazyLoading() {
    const images = document.querySelectorAll('img');
    
    // Use Intersection Observer with conservative threshold
    // rootMargin: '50px' means only load images within 50px of viewport
    // This prevents loading images passed through during hash navigation
    imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0) {
          const img = entry.target;
          // Only load if image is actually visible (not just passed through)
          if (img.dataset.src) {
            img.src = img.dataset.src;
            img.removeAttribute('data-src');
          } else if (!img.hasAttribute('loading')) {
            // For images without data-src, use native lazy loading
            img.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
          }
          observer.unobserve(img);
        }
      });
    }, {
      rootMargin: '50px',  // Only load images within 50px of viewport
      threshold: 0.01      // Trigger when at least 1% visible
    });
    
    images.forEach(img => {
      imageObserver.observe(img);
    });
  }
  
  // Handle hash navigation (clicking links to sections)
  // Delay loading to avoid loading images passed through during jump
  function handleHashNavigation() {
    if (loadTimeout) clearTimeout(loadTimeout);
    // Wait 300ms after navigation to let scroll settle
    // Images will load naturally via Intersection Observer when visible
    loadTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      // Scroll has settled, Intersection Observer will handle visible images
      // No action needed - observer is already watching
    }, 300);
  }
  
  // Initialize on page load
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', enableLazyLoading);
  } else {
    enableLazyLoading();
  }
  
  // Handle hash changes (clicking anchor links)
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHashNavigation);
  
  // Also handle initial hash if page loads with one
  if (window.location.hash) {
    setTimeout(handleHashNavigation, 100);
  }
})();
</script>
